race.title: Railway Bar Lismullen Hurdle (Grade 2)
race.verdict: SLADE STEEL has not progressed as hoped since his 2024 Supreme success, but his return to hurdles when last seen duly sparked a revival and he is fancied to make a winning reappearance. The Yellow Clay is a smart hurdler with a good course record to his name and is feared most, with Feet of A Dancer also very much respected due to her excellent record when fresh. SLADE STEEL (IRE) THE YELLOW CLAY (IRE) FEET OF A DANCER (FR)
